metric: DEVICE KERNEL DURATION [ns]; ONE fresh ttnn.generic_op program per (config, variant); no trial loop. Headline cells repeated 3x (run-to-run spread < 1.5%) and reported as the median.
precision_contract: FIXED on every variant: fp32 partial/stat CBs, HiFi2, fp32_dest_acc_en=False, math_approx_mode=False, TILE. NEVER a lever.
baseline: flat == the op's CURRENT combine, carried verbatim: D16/D22 row-major gather at GATHER_SLOTS (== GROUP_SIZE rounded up to even), the writer's gather_zero boot of the unshipped faces, gather_sem.wait_min(GROUP_SIZE-1), the D22 FUSED root chain (pairwise add_tiles with acc_to_dest over GATHER_HALF + D17 column-scoped raw-sfpi finalize + ONE pack_tile), D24 mcast ordering.
candidate: tree_<f0>x<f1>[x<f2>...] == a k-ary tree over the SLOT axis at m == 1 (row split OFF, so it COMPOSES with compact_partial_transpose). stride[0]=1, stride[l+1]=stride[l]*f_l; participant at level l iff slot%stride[l]==0; GATHERER at level l iff slot%stride[l+1]==0. Interior gatherers run the identical pairwise DEST fold but pack the RAW sum (NO finalize) and forward it; only slot 0 (the mcast root, unique last-level gatherer because prod(F) >= GROUP_SIZE is asserted) applies the rsqrt. tree_<G> is the L=1 corner == flat through the generic path: the OVERHEAD CONTROL.
why_this_dir_and_not_hierarchical_gather: r2 measured a 2-level (K,m) grid against the PRE-D22 root chain and its winner was the row split (m=BLOCK_ROWS), which is mutually exclusive with compact_partial_transpose. This dir isolates the slot half at m=1 and REBASES the baseline onto D22. The rebase is decisive at small groups: the r2 focus baseline was 46436 ns, the D22 baseline of the same cell is 29933 ns, and the tree win at GROUP_SIZE=8 went from r2's 1.12x (k4_m1) to 1.00x.

focus_g8_br8_r32.geometry: (1,1,8192,1024) BLOCK_SHARDED shard [1024,128] grid (8,8) = 64 cores; G=8, num_groups=8, BLOCK_ROWS=8, 32 tile-rows/core -> 4 combine rounds
focus_g8_br8_r32.verdict: NULL. Best tree = 1.00x. Deeper is worse (2x2x2 = 0.90x). The D22 fold of 8 tiles is too cheap to pay for a NoC hop.

w5120_g32_br1_r1.geometry: (1,1,32,5120) WIDTH_SHARDED shard [32,160] grid (8,4) = 32 cores; G=32, BLOCK_ROWS=1, 1 round
w5120_g32_br1_r1.verdict: WIN. tree_4x8 = 1.45x. 2 levels optimal; 3 levels 1.36-1.40x; 4 levels 1.22x.

w7168_g28_br1_r1.geometry: (1,1,32,7168) WIDTH_SHARDED shard [32,256] grid (7,4) = 28 cores; G=28, BLOCK_ROWS=1, 1 round
w7168_g28_br1_r1.verdict: WIN. tree_4x7 = 1.40x. RAGGED chunks (28 = 4x7 exact, 4x8 pads one level-1 slot) are correct with no guard.

focus_compact_g8_br1_r4.geometry: the focus geometry AS compact_partial_transpose would leave it: 1 compact partial tile per sender per round, same 4 rounds (BLOCK_ROWS=1, num_rows=4). Also the cell where the ROW SPLIT is inexpressible.
focus_compact_g8_br1_r4.verdict: REGRESSION 0.76x at GROUP_SIZE=8. Compaction removes the per-round row count that was paying for the hop.

compact_g32_br1_r4.geometry: the SAME compaction-composed transport at a group wide enough to win: G=32, 1 tile/sender/round, 4 rounds
compact_g32_br1_r4.verdict: WIN 1.25x. THE COMPOSABILITY ANSWER: the tree survives compaction at wide groups, and it is the ONLY lever left there (m <= BLOCK_ROWS == 1).

statement: f0 = 4                                        # measured level-0 fan-in optimum; f0=8 is 1.38x vs f0=4's 1.45x at G=32, f0=7 is 1.26x vs f0=4's 1.40x at G=28
f1 = ceil(GROUP_SIZE / f0)                    # TWO levels, always -- 3 and 4 levels are measured WORSE at every cell but one
rows = min(BLOCK_ROWS, tile-rows per round)   # the partial tile-rows a sender ships PER ROUND (== 1 under compact_partial_transpose)
use the TREE iff f1 >= 2 and rows * (GROUP_SIZE - f0 - f1) >= 17
otherwise keep the FLAT root (unchanged op)
rule.derivation_of_the_17: rows*(G - f0 - f1) is the count of root fold-tiles the tree takes off the per-round critical path; the tree pays exactly ONE extra NoC hop per round for them. The threshold is bracketed by two measured cells: 16 deleted tiles (G=8, rows=8 -- the focus shape) is 1.00x, and 17 (G=28, rows=1 -- the w7168 target) is 1.40x. It is not a smooth function of this quantity alone -- above GROUP_SIZE=16 the SECOND mechanism dominates (the flat root's G-1 remote partial writes serialise into ONE core's L1 ingress and its gather_zero boot walks GATHER_SLOTS*BLOCK_ROWS pages; the tree caps both at max(f0,f1))-- so 17 is where the ingress term starts paying, not a fold-cost crossover.

cells_the_rule_keeps_flat.g4_*: f1 == 1, tree deletes ZERO fold tiles (f0+f1 == GROUP_SIZE) -- r2's GROUP_SIZE==4 carve-out RE-DERIVED and it is the tree's, confirmed at 0.78x / 0.85x / 1.02x
cells_the_rule_keeps_flat.g16_br1: 8 deleted tiles; the 1-round 1.08x is a boot-zero FIXED-cost artifact -- the per-round marginal is a LOSS (tree 2362 vs flat 2053 ns/round) and the 4-round cell measures 0.94x

rule.accuracy: the rule's arity is the best measured or within 0.4% at 4 of 7 selected cells, and 5.2% / 8.5% off the best at g32_br8 (picks 4x8 = 1.75x, best 4x4x2 = 1.85x) and g8_br32 (picks 4x2 = 1.22x, best 2x4 = 1.33x). It never selects a cell measured below 1.00x.

precision.direction: the tree is MORE accurate than flat at EVERY cell measured, not less -- same mechanism D22 recorded against D16: a deeper pairwise DEST tree shortens the error chain.
precision.gate: pcc >= 0.9995 (the focus case's soft threshold) and rel-RMS <= 0.04, both on the lanes the datapath carries (columns 0,2..14). Every variant in every table above PASSED both. No variant traded precision for speed; NO variant needed to.
precision.identity_check: tree_<G> (the L=1 generic-path corner) reproduces flat's pcc and rel-RMS to all printed digits at every cell -- the generic path is not a different computation.

integration_facts.generic_path_overhead: tree_<G> vs flat is a reproducible 0.97-1.00x on the big cells and 0.92-0.97x on the small ones (5594 vs 5424 at w5120, 2670 vs 2463 at g8_br1) -- i.e. 3-8% for the tree walk's arithmetic, the per-level parent/pos/cnt resolution and the RT coord-table reads, on a path where L==1. A production spelling that if-constexprs the (L==1) body back to the flat one pays 0; the bench keeps the generic corner precisely so the coordinator can see what it would cost NOT to.
integration_facts.semaphores: ONE PER LEVEL, and that is not negotiable: a level-(l+1) sender only has to finish its OWN level-l chunk, which is a DIFFERENT chunk from its parent's, so it can legally arrive before one of the parent's level-l members and a single cumulative counter would let that inc satisfy the parent's level-l wait_min and fold a slot that has not landed. The rule's 2-level tree needs 2 (mcast's 2 + 2 = 4 total, against NUM_SEMAPHORES = 16 per core).
integration_facts.no_self_signal: preserved at every level. An interior node is BOTH receiver and sender: it writes its own slot synchronously and waits for exactly cnt-1 REMOTE incs. Semaphore::up(value) is a non-atomic local RMW and is never used on a counter the core itself owns.
integration_facts.l1: the flat root's ring is GATHER_SLOTS*BLOCK_ROWS pages; the tree declares f_l-rounded-to-even * BLOCK_ROWS per level on every core plus one node_out page-block. At the rule's cells that is 132 -> 56 kB (w5120), 116 -> 56 kB (w7168), 1056 -> 448 kB (g32_br8), 928 -> 448 kB (g28_br8). At GROUP_SIZE=8 it is 288 -> 256 kB, i.e. nearly nothing -- the tree at m=1 does NOT hand back the L1 the row split does, because it keeps BLOCK_ROWS in every ring.
integration_facts.flow_control: unchanged in kind. A remote sender is gated by the PREVIOUS round's stat multicast, which the root sends only after its own last-level fold, which requires every level-(L-1) forward, which requires each level-(L-2) gatherer to have drained its ring -- down to level 0. Same argument the op already relies on for its single root.
integration_facts.ragged_and_odd_groups: one code path, no guard. Each level's ring is f_l rounded UP TO EVEN (D22's own trick) and every slot a ragged chunk has no real member for is boot-zeroed WHOLE, pairing against a real contributor as an exact +0.0. Verified correct at GROUP_SIZE=9 (odd) and GROUP_SIZE=28 with both an exact factorisation (4x7) and a padded one (4x8, 3x3x4).
integration_facts.interior_forward_is_whole_tile: faces 1/3 of a folded tile are the ring's boot zeros carried through DEST, so a level>=1 forward is exact as ONE whole-tile transaction and needs no second zeroing pass. Level 0 keeps the op's GATHER_FACES=2 (half the bytes, two transactions).
